==90%==
Which of these sticks was put down on the table first?

[[File:Sticks.png|frameless]]

B is on top, then D, then C, then E, then A – so A must have been put down first.

==70%==
Blue elephants are not as big as red elephants. Yellow elephants are smaller than blue elephants. Green elephants are never separated from red elephants. The largest elephant is always at the back. What is the correct elephant order?

[[File:Elephants.png|frameless]]

Green and red elephants are never separated so it has to be B.

==25%==
If you had 8 fingers on your left hand, 6 fingers on your right hand, the same number of toes on your right foot as your left hand and 3 toes on your left foot, how many fingers and toes would you have in total?

8 fingers + 6 fingers + 8 toes + 3 toes = '''25'''.

==15%==
A chessboard has eight squares along each side. How many squares are there in total on the four sides around the outside of the chessboard?

'''28''': Although there are eight squares along each side, each corner square can only be counted once.

==10%==
Logically, other than all having one syllable, what connects this group of words?

SLACK '''B'''LACK<br>GRANGE '''O'''RANGE<br>LED '''R'''ED<br>SINK '''P'''INK

They are all colours with their first letter changed.

==5%==
On a standard analogue clock face, how many digits appear exactly once?

'''8''': 0 in the 10 and then 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8, 9.

==1%==
What number should replace the question mark?

JAMAICA + JAPAN = 124<br>ARGENTINA + ARMENIA = 1245<br>FRANCE + BRAZIL = 23<br>ENGLAND + GERMANY = '''56'''

The numbers are the positions of any shared letters… e.g. Argentina and Armenia share the 1st, 2nd, 4th and 5th letters. So England and Germany is 56, for the A and the N.
